title: Senior Account Manager, Enterprise Client Services
description:
About Sezzle:

With a mission to financially empower the next generation, Sezzle is revolutionizing the shopping experience beyond payments, blending cutting-edge tech with seamless, interest-free installment plans that make shopping smarter and more accessible. We’re not just transforming payments; we’re redefining how people discover, interact with, and purchase the things they love while driving real impact on merchant sales through increased conversions and higher order values. As we continue to shape the future of fintech and retail, we’re building an innovative, dynamic team passionate about creating more than just a transaction but a truly unique shopping journey. If you’re excited about pushing boundaries in tech and delivering a game-changing experience for consumers and merchants alike, come join us at Sezzle and help create the future of shopping!

About the Role

Sezzle is seeking a Senior Account Manager, Enterprise Client Services who is best in class with a high IQ plus a high EQ. This role presents an exciting opportunity to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment within a rapidly growing team, with abundant prospects for career advancement.

Sezzle's Enterprise Client Services team serves as the strategic partner to many of our largest and most valuable merchants. As a Senior Account Manager, you'll own a portfolio of Enterprise accounts, serving as the primary point of contact from implementation through long-term growth and renewal. You'll partner closely with Sales, Engineering, Product, Marketing, Legal, Risk, and Support to deliver an exceptional merchant experience while identifying opportunities to expand the partnership and drive revenue growth.

This is a senior individual contributor role designed for someone who can independently manage complex Enterprise relationships, confidently communicate with executive stakeholders, and proactively solve problems before they impact the merchant experience. While this role does not include direct people management responsibilities, it requires strong leadership, ownership, and cross-functional influence.

What You’ll Own

  • Serve as the primary relationship owner for a portfolio of Enterprise merchants, managing the partnership from implementation through renewal.
  • Develop a deep understanding of each merchant's business, goals, competitive landscape, key initiatives, and performance metrics to become the internal expert on every assigned account.
  • Drive account growth by identifying opportunities to expand product adoption, launch new channels, introduce new Sezzle products, and negotiate commercial renewals.
  • Own account health and retention by proactively monitoring merchant performance, identifying potential risks early, and coordinating internal teams to resolve issues before they impact the client experience.
  • Lead Enterprise merchant onboarding, implementations, and new product launches by coordinating work across Engineering, Product, Marketing, Legal, Revenue Operations, Risk, and Support.
  • Act as the quarterback for your accounts, ensuring internal teams remain aligned and merchants receive timely, accurate, and consistent communication.
  • Translate technical discussions, internal updates, and cross-functional feedback into polished, merchant-ready communications that represent Sezzle with a single, professional voice.
  • Prepare and deliver Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs), executive business updates, and strategic account plans that leverage performance data to identify opportunities and guide future growth.
  • Partner closely with Data & Analytics to interpret merchant performance, including approval rates, order volume, customer behavior, AOV, LTV, and product adoption, using insights to drive strategic recommendations.
  • Maintain strong documentation of account history, strategic plans, launches, renewals, meeting notes, and key decisions to ensure continuity across the organization.
  • Maintain high responsiveness to merchant communications while keeping internal stakeholders informed through dedicated account channels and regular updates.
  • Continuously monitor industry trends, merchant performance, and competitive activity to proactively identify opportunities and risks for your portfolio.
  • Embrace AI-powered tools and automation to improve productivity, streamline workflows, create client-facing materials, and deliver a best-in-class merchant experience

What We’re Looking For

  • 5+ years of experience in Enterprise Account Management, Client Services, Customer Success, Strategic Partnerships, or another client-facing commercial role, preferably within payments, fintech, SaaS, or e-commerce.
  • Proven success managing complex Enterprise customer relationships with responsibility for retention, account growth, renewals, and executive stakeholder management.
  • Experience leading complex cross-functional projects involving Product, Engineering, Legal, Marketing, Support, and Operations.
  • Strong commercial acumen with experience negotiating renewals, pricing discussions, and partnership expansions.
  • Excellent analytical skills with the ability to interpret performance data and turn insights into actionable business recommendations.
  • Outstanding written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate effectively from technical teams to C-level executives.
  • Highly organized with exceptional project management skills and the ability to manage multiple high-priority accounts simultaneously.
  • Demonstrated ability to operate independently with a high degree of ownership, accountability, and sound judgment.
  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Finance, Economics, Computer Science or related field.
  • Demonstrated experience working with Claude or equivalent large language model tools is required; candidates must be comfortable leveraging AI to enhance productivity, research, and communication.

Preferred

  • Experience in Buy Now, Pay Later (BNPL), payments, card processing, or broader fintech.
  • Familiarity with Salesforce, Vitally, Redash, or similar CRM and analytics platforms.
  • Experience working in a fast-paced, high-growth startup environment.
  • Experience managing large strategic merchants.

Compensation

The total compensation range for the role is $110,000 - $140,000 base salary. Our ranges are very broad to accommodate all types of candidates and encourage growth. Specific compensation offered to a candidate may be dependent on factors such as education, experience, qualifications, and alignment with market data. Exceptional candidates may receive salaries outside of the posted ranges.

Perks & Benefits:

  • Competitive salary
  • Unlimited PTO, volunteer hours and sabbatical
  • Life, STD/LTD, medical, dental and vision insurance
  • Highly discounted LifeTime gym membership
  • 401k with match
  • Collaborative fun co-workers
  • The opportunity to join the fastest growing FinTech alongside a team of motivated and driven individuals

Sezzle's Employee Privacy Policy: At Sezzle, we care about protecting your personal information. We encourage you to review it to understand how your information is collected, used, and safeguarded. You can read the full policy here: https://legal.sezzle.com/state-employee-privacy-policy.

By submitting your application, you acknowledge that you have read and understood this CCPA disclosure.

Equal Employment Opportunity: Sezzle Inc. is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, pregnancy, or any other legally protected status. Sezzle recognizes and values the importance of diversity and inclusion in enriching the employment experience of its employees and in supporting our mission.
